items: Vector effects: inner shadow, inner glow and the edge bevel are drawn a new way — no more stray stripes, and a sharp (softness 0) inner shadow is no longer cut off

Palette packs: Palette ⋯ → Palette packs — 35 ready palettes from 2 to 256 colors: classic (PICO-8, Game Boy, CGA, web safe…), big ramps (up to 256), greys, skin tones, hair, eyes, forest, ocean, sky, desert, ice, fire, autumn, spring, pastel, neon, candy, night city, spooky, muted, metals, wood & stone
Use replaces your palette, + Add adds the new colors to it; Ctrl+Z brings the old palette back
Vector gradients: as many colors as you like (click the gradient bar to add one, drag the marks to move, Remove, ⇄ to turn it around)
New gradient kinds: Rings, Sweep (around the center) and Stripes, plus Straight and Round
Gradient center, size and number of repeats; the Gradient tool (Shift+G) sets the center and size for round ones by dragging
Folders that stay only on this device: right-click a folder → “Only on this device (no cloud sync)”, or New → “Folder only on this device”. They get a ⌂ mark and cloud sync never sends or fills them
MP4 export rewritten: real H.264 MP4 files made frame by frame (exact timing, plays and seeks everywhere, faster than real time), sound included
Playback follows the clock: no more slowing down, a late frame is skipped instead of dragging
Playback is prepared in the background while you rest, so Play starts at once; the timeline is barely touched while playing
Onion skin: ghost frames are kept ready, stepping through frames is much quicker
Settings → Speed: Fast mode for weak laptops (fewer screen pixels on high-DPI screens), Auto picks it for weak computers
Duplicate several frames at once: select them (Shift + click on the frame numbers or cels) and press D or the duplicate button — the copies go right after them and stay selected
Timeline: Backspace empties the current cel; with cels selected (Shift + click) Backspace or Delete empties all of them; with whole frames selected it removes the frames. Ctrl+Z brings them back
Vector art stays sharp while playing (it was prepared at camera size and looked pixelated when zoomed in)
Vector: shape animation ◆ — make a key on a later frame (Shift+K), change the shapes there, the frames in between move by themselves (every point follows), with easing
Vector: clicking a shape takes you to its layer; Ctrl+A selects shapes on all layers, the selection box works across layers
Vector effects: Light & 3D with a ball to place the sun (highlight, shade, sun glint, edge bevel), inner shadow, inner glow, materials: glass, metal, chrome, gold, plastic, satin
Vector tools: Liquify (W: push, twirl, pinch, puff up), Scissors (C), Paint bucket (G), Gradient by dragging (Shift+G), Spiral (Shift+S)
Vector: polygon is now Y (N adds a frame again), Alt + arrows move shapes (arrows change frames)
Joined / cut shapes: the outline now follows the real edge, no more notches where the shapes meet
Vector brush (B): draw freely, the line becomes points you can move with A; smooth curves or sharp zigzag, smoothness setting
Points: make one point or the whole shape smooth or sharp, double-click a line (A) to add a point
Combine shapes: Join, Cut out (the top shape cuts itself out), Overlap, Hole (the overlap becomes empty), Take apart
Snapping to the points and the outlines of other shapes
Stroke width stays the same when scaling (can be switched off), stroke inside / outside, custom dashes, arrows and dots on line ends, round gradients
Position and size fields (X, Y, W, H, turn)
Effects: shadow, glow, blur, blend modes, textures (dots, stripes, hatching, grain…) or your own picture
Brush, Animation, Render and Export settings are now separate windows: F5, F6, F7, F8 (or the ☰ button). Move them anywhere, they remember their place. The canvas gets the space
Vector art: Selection (V) — move, scale, turn, Alt-drag copies; Direct selection (A) — edit points and curves; Pen (P); Rectangle, Ellipse, Polygon, Star, Line; Eyedropper
Vector art: fill and stroke colors (X switches, Shift+X swaps), gradient fill, dashed / dotted strokes, ends and corners, round corners
Vector art: arrange (Ctrl+[ ]), align and spread evenly, flip, turn 90°, copy / paste / duplicate, smart guides that stick to other shapes and the camera
Vector art has its own simple menu: only Rectangle and Circle
Shapes are real vector shapes: fill with the current color, outline with its own color and width, round corners, opacity
The Brush tab becomes the Shape tab in vector files; old vector drawings still show as before
Phone: no black frames around the canvas while zooming out or moving
Phone: pinch zoom in pixel art no longer jumps 100% → 200%: it stays exactly where you leave it
Phone: zoom and moving the canvas follow your fingers instantly (the picture is redrawn when you stop)
Phone: ✋ Hand button — move around the canvas with one finger, without zooming or drawing
Phone: all tools fit on the screen (two rows), bigger buttons, windows no longer go off the screen
Phone: pinch zoom is smooth (pixel art snaps to a whole zoom when you let go)
Phone: onion skins no longer lag behind when you move the canvas with two fingers
Phone: big animations play without filling the memory (no more crashes when playing)
Very big files are skipped by cloud sync instead of crashing it
Phone: .sdt / .sdp / .sdv / .sdz and Aseprite files can be picked for import again
Files without a proper name are recognised by what is inside
“Open with Starman Does Animations”: double-click .sdt / .sdp / .sdv / .sdz files in Explorer, and open .aseprite files with it (the Android app too)
Computer updates now also update the program part, not only the page
Cloud sync: the same animations on your computer and phone (Start → Cloud sync). Files are kept in your own private GitHub storage
Syncs by itself after saving, every few minutes and when the app opens; the ☁ button on the taskbar shows the state
If one file was changed on two devices, both versions are kept
Phone and tablet layout: full-screen canvas, tools at the bottom, palette, settings and timeline slide up
Touch: two fingers zoom and move the canvas, two-finger tap = undo, three-finger tap = redo
Install on Android as an app (from the web page, or the APK)
This “What’s new” window, and “Check for updates” in the Start menu
Big animations no longer hit the 5 MB browser limit (files are kept in IndexedDB)
Sprite layers: animated clips with their own tab, ◆ keys choose idle / run / jump…
Hide a sprite on some frames, remove keys on selected frames
◆ motion keys for any layer with the Move tool (“Whole layer”)
Hue / Saturation window (Ctrl+U) like Aseprite
More export formats: Animated PNG, MP4, sheet + JSON, WebP / JPEG
.sdz packages to move animations to another computer
Free transform: scale, turn, slant (Ctrl), one corner (Alt)
Templates gallery with tags and layer colors
Camera zoom and turn while playing
